description: Deploy autonomous AI agents in Liberia. Run 24/7 cloud computers, automate trade workflows, browser research, and Telegram operations effortlessly.
h1: Run Autonomous AI Agents Across Liberia
sub: Empower your enterprise in Monrovia and beyond with 24/7 cloud computers that manage research, coding, communication, and workflows uninterrupted.
audience: Liberian entrepreneurs, logistics brokers at the Freeport of Monrovia, agribusiness exporters, software developers, and cross-border trade consultants.
manifesto: Whether your phone is off or network connectivity drops, your Ceyo agents stay active on dedicated cloud computers, running operations, processing imports, and tracking international markets around the clock.

uses.d: Monitor shipments arriving at the Freeport of Monrovia, cross-check manifests, and update import logs in Google Sheets automatically.
Gather real-time international commodity pricing for rubber, palm oil, and cocoa, compiling daily intelligence for exporters.
Deploy personal Telegram agents to answer buyer questions, route price quotes, and manage client requests instantly.
Extract data from supplier invoices, parse complex trade documentation, and produce executive briefing reports.
Let an autonomous coding agent build, test, and deploy software in isolated environments without needing high-end local hardware.
Conduct deep web research across policy databases, synthesize complex white papers, and share long-form summaries to Notion.

steps.d: Select Plus ($20/mo), Pro ($60/mo), or Ultra ($120/mo) and start your 3-day free trial.
Connect Telegram, integrate your existing apps, and configure your bots to execute tasks.
Your agents execute autonomously in isolated cloud computers even when your devices are offline.

chapters.d: Your Ceyo agent monitors maritime arrival logs and currency rates while you commute along Tubman Boulevard. It compiles key updates into your morning inbox before the workday starts.

Collaborative bots in your Telegram group share procurement drafts and update inventory spreadsheets across teams. Everything syncs smoothly across Gmail and Google Sheets without manual intervention.
A specialized coding agent finishes building a customer intake portal and tests endpoints in the cloud. It sends a voice summary of resolved issues directly to your phone.

Even after your laptop is turned off and network connections fluctuate, your isolated cloud computer stays fully operational. Autonomous web browsing and scheduled research continue through the night.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and how does the free trial work?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens daily, and your linked card is billed only after the trial concludes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Will my agents stop working if my power or internet cuts out?
faq.a: No. Every agent operates on its own isolated 24/7 cloud computer, ensuring that data gathering, form automation, and scheduled routines run reliably even if your phone or computer loses power.

faq.q: Can I control my Ceyo agents through Telegram in Liberia?
faq.a: Yes. You can manage personal Telegram bots directly or introduce multiple AI agents into group chats, allowing a team of autonomous specialists to collaborate on your daily operations.

faq.q: Which languages and business skills do Ceyo bots handle?
faq.a: Ceyo bots operate fluently in English and hundreds of world languages. They handle autonomous web research, software programming, spreadsheet data entry, and voice or phone agent workflows.

faq.q: How easily does Ceyo connect with my existing business tools?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with over 1,000 popular business applications, including Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, Notion, calendars, and customer relationship management platforms.
